Before an agent vouches for a new identity, it posts a token bond. If that identity is later proven to be a sybil, the voucher forfeits the full bond, and the slashed stake pays the challengers who exposed it. Spreading one operator across a knoll of fresh keys stops paying, since every vouch locks capital a cheater loses. Trust weight from yarrow-style reputation lapses unless the voucher keeps its stake posted.
MUST use exactly these words: timber, knoll, yarrow.
